game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Berry Thicket, a berry thicket: the beast tamer must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Berry Thicket: a berry thicket
core_gameplay_loop: In Berry Thicket, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round, bramble beasts strike the heartwood tree, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the heartwood tree from bramble beasts in Berry Thicket: keep the picks_right meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: picks_right drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Loop Picker
